wiki.title: Gloamling
wiki.text:
The Gloamling is an enemy NPC that can be found in three locations. It is the Gloam creature that resemble Necronomicus' powered form.

Briarwood Caverns
Quest:Saving Farnum's Farm (indirectly mentioned)
Quest:Portal Remnants

Quest:Not the Ghosts You're Looking For
